newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro to redeem $74 mln in public debt.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro to redeem $74 mln in public debt.

text.p: Tesoro Petroleum Corp said on Monday it would full redeem its two public debt issues, totalling about $74 million.
The company said in a statement it would incur a non-cash pre-tax $3.2 million extraordinary loss in the third quarter, from the early debt retirement.

The debt was comprised of $44.1 million of outstanding 13 percent exchange notes due December 1, 2000 and $30 million of outstanding 12-3/4 percent subordinated debentures due March 15, 2001. The redemption date was now November 8, it said.
The debt would be redeemed at 100 percent of the principal amount plus accrued interest to the redemption date, it said.
Tesoro Chairman Bruce Smith said in a statement the company was using proceeds from a natural gas dispute with Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co to reitre the debt.
Tennessee Gas paid Tesoro $67.5 million for a prior underpayment of a natural gas contract, Tesoro said. The contract had been the subject of a long-running legal dispute between the two companies.
Of these funds, $7.9 million was for unaccrued interest and reimbursement of legal fees and court costs. This would result in pre-tax income for Tesoro in the third quarter, it said.

Smith said by retiring the public debt, the company's debt-to-capitalization ratio would fall to below 30 percent and interest expense would decrease by almost $10 million annually, or about $0.25 per share.
